findings.conclusion: The public schema description specifies eleven columns but names ten roles. The proposed exact-label first-record rule is explicitly a prospective acceptance profile, not an observed layout; unknown eleventh semantics and every body-field dictionary remain unbound even after KNOWN_ROLES_PARTIAL.

The contract truthfully separates whole-body acquisition, full text decoding, full CSV cell parsing and researcher-visible closed output. It treats examples/options/comments as potentially empirical and preserves partial-failure exposure; no claim of target-free or untouched evidence follows from output withholding.

Per-test endpoint documentary association is not verified pairing. Expanded marginal measurement uncertainty is not a hard enclosure, prediction interval or selected-pool joint guarantee. Finite-frame design would require its own fixed labels/randomization; no IID premise, candidate diversity or source readiness is invented.

This deliberately partial lexical inventory is a defensible smallest engineering option but cannot by itself resolve eleven-versus-ten role semantics or G20/G21. Keep the implementation choice open until its informational value is compared with separately scoped missing-header documentary evidence; do not present this as a complete dictionary adapter.
